data.name: AMIMI
data.detailed_description:
A singular adventure where the unexpected feels like home. Explore a handcrafted natural world filled with wondrous beings. Each puzzle plays by its own weird rules, inviting you to experiment. Embark on a journey about friendship, transformation and the healing power of nature; told through the bond between a child and a creature.

Exploration — Follow Your Curiosity

  • Explore a handcrafted world filled with secrets and surprises.

  • Meet curious characters, like Totoshori and Ashiitake, and discover stories.

  • Every corner reveals hidden wonders and curious creatures: Find all the Mushiis!

Puzzles — Experiment and Discover

  • Solve inventive puzzles through observation, experimentation, and creative thinking.

  • Discover unexpected interactions between creatures, Amimi and the environment.

  • Use Amimi's unique powers and abilities in each situation.

Friendship — Grow Together

  • Watch Amimi evolve into different forms throughout the adventure.

  • Unlock new abilities that open up fresh ways to explore and solve puzzles.

  • Learn how Nuez and Amimi complement each other as their friendship grows.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-4300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 / AMD Radeon HD 7750
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Gamepad recommended.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey
  • Processor: Apple Silicon or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal compatible graphics card
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible sound device
  • Additional Notes: Apple Silicon supported.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 / SteamOS 3.0 or equivalent
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan-compatible graphics card
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA compatible sound device
  • Additional Notes: 64-bit operating system required.
